name: The St. Regis Costa Mujeres Resort, Cancun
positioning: St. Regis beachfront resort in Costa Mujeres, north of Cancun, designed by Sordo Madaleno around Mayan legends
best_for: Travelers who want St. Regis Butler Service in every room category
Couples who want a suite with a private pool
Families who want a kids club and a kids' pool

facts.text: The resort is a beachfront resort in Costa Mujeres, about 30 minutes north of Cancun Airport.
Every room and suite has a private terrace, with views of sunrise over the sea and sunset behind the mangroves of Isla Blanca.
Suites feature astrological motifs brought to life through light and custom fixtures.
Rooms have marble bathrooms with soaking tubs.
The resort has five restaurants: Costa Coral, Fish Market, Palmare Grill, The St. Regis Bar and Olivia.
Costa Coral serves Mexican cuisine rooted in the biodiversity of the milpa and is open for breakfast and dinner.
Fish Market is a seafood restaurant with a raw bar, ceviches and shared rice dishes.
Palmare Grill is an oceanfront restaurant serving artisanal breads, sun-seared meats and coastal dishes made for sharing.
Olivia is a specialty coffee spot showcasing Mexican coffees with an artisanal bakery selection.
St. Regis Butler service is available in all accommodations.
The St. Regis Family Traditions program runs at the resort's Explorer's Club.
Guests can explore nearby reefs by boat.

highlights.text: The resort was designed by the firm Sordo Madaleno and reimagines Mayan legends in stone, wood and metal.
Some suites have private pools overlooking the Mesoamerican Barrier Reef and the mangrove reserve near Isla Blanca.
Each evening butlers open bottles of Champagne with sabers to mark the transition from day to night.
The spa offers ancestral Mayan treatments and rituals inspired by the sea and the legacy of El Meco.
The St. Regis Bar sits next to the Agave Library, a communal immersive bar.

considerations.text: The hotel does not provide shuttle service; Cancun International Airport is about 26.9 km away.
Breakfast is served at Costa Coral for a fee.
WhataHotel notes the resort is located away from Cancun's main tourist attractions.
